title: Speech to Patience
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. This bridge then carries into guru ties patience to listening, honor, and steadiness rather than passive resentment.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Speak what carries honor, not just what releases heat.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Restraint is sometimes the most truthful form of speech.
